method: Local Windows OCR (zh-Hans-CN), every decoded image/GIF frame, pattern checks and visual review of flagged generic paths. Input hashes must match the current public assets.

redaction: New installer captures use local 12px blur before writing PNGs. The capture checks computed blur styles, including low-effects mode and visible node tooltips. Unblurred installer captures and OCR text are excluded from published assets.
limits: OCR and pattern checks can miss account names, QR codes, private hosts or illegible text. This report does not certify every asset as free of sensitive information; new or changed media requires another review.
